title: Blastoise Can Snipe an Empty Can From Over 160 Feet Away
premise: Blastoise is not just a water cannon. Its shell spouts can precisely hit empty cans from over 160 feet away.
audiencePromise: See why Blastoise is built like both a precision sniper and a steel-punching cannon.
openLoop: How can Blastoise hit an empty can far away while firing cannon-level water jets?
payoff: Blastoise pairs can-level accuracy with water cannons powerful enough to punch holes through thick steel.
engagementQuestion: Would you trust its aim or its steel-punching force?

voice.instructions: Deliver with controlled suspense and crisp emphasis. Start quiet and precise, then build forcefully on steel and recoil. Leave a short beat before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: EMPTY CAN. 160+ FEET.

scenes.headline: WATER BULLETS, NOT A SPRAY
